description: This file contains unit tests for the backend API's health check endpoints, specifically testing the /health and /status endpoints in a Spring Boot application. The tests start a real server environment without a database, using mocks where necessary, and verify the HTTP responses and payload contents.

classes.name: test_BackendHealthFullStackTest
classes.description: Test class for health and status endpoints of the backend API, simulating full-stack behavior with a real server environment but without an actual database.

methods.name: health_returns200Up
methods.description: Tests that the /health endpoint returns a 200 status with a body indicating the system is UP.

methods.name: status_returns503WhenNoDataSource
methods.description: Tests that the /status endpoint returns a 503 status and indicates the database is DOWN when no data source is available.
